Class CaptureRecord

java.lang.Object
CaptureRecord
public class CaptureRecord extends Object
CaptureRecord Purpose: Holds the immutable record of a single capture.

  • Constructor Details

    • CaptureRecord

      private CaptureRecord(Pirate capturedPirate, Character captor, Status status, int bountyClaimed)
      CONSTRUCTOR Purpose: Initializes a new capture record. Private on purpose - records may only be produced by attemptCapture, which guarantees the arguments have already been validated and are never null.
      Parameters:
      capturedPirate - the pirate who was taken or killed
      captor - the non-pirate who claimed them
      status - the target's resulting status
      bountyClaimed - the reward paid out for this capture

    • validateCaptor

      private static void validateCaptor(Character captor) throws InvalidCaptorException
      Purpose: Enforces the rule that a pirate may never claim a bounty.
      Parameters:
      captor - the character attempting the capture
      Throws:
      InvalidCaptorException - if the captor is null or is a Pirate

    • processTargetStatus

      private static void processTargetStatus(Pirate target, boolean isDead)
      Purpose: Applies the outcome of the capture to the target. A dead pirate is struck from their crew roster; a captured one keeps their berth but stops contributing to the crew's active bounty total.
      Parameters:
      target - the pirate being captured
      isDead - true if the target was killed rather than taken alive

    • claimBounty

      private static int claimBounty(Pirate target, Character captor)
      Purpose: Pays out the reward and clears the target's bounty so it cannot be claimed twice. A marine's reward goes to their corps' operational funds; an unaffiliated marine is paid personally instead.
      Parameters:
      target - the captured pirate whose bounty is being claimed
      captor - the character receiving the reward
      Returns:
      the amount paid out in Berries

    • attemptCapture

      public static CaptureRecord attemptCapture(Pirate target, Character captor, boolean isDead) throws InvalidCaptorException
      Purpose: Runs a full capture - validation, status change, and payout - in the correct order.
      Parameters:
      target - the pirate being captured, rejected if null or not currently FREE
      captor - the character making the capture
      isDead - true if the target was killed rather than taken alive
      Returns:
      the resulting capture record
      Throws:
      InvalidCaptorException - if the captor is null or a pirate
      IllegalArgumentException - if the target is null or is not FREE
